name: Red Card Kinetic
summary: Loud lowercase kinetic type on a full-screen red grid card: white Poppins Black word stacks, tall Six Caps key words, spring entrances and a liquid-ink wipe. No footage needed.

palette.use: the red card: the mid stop of its radial gradient, the ground of every frame
dark UI mock-up panels on the card (terminal, bar readout) (proposed)
every word on the red card, chips, beams and diagram strokes
the 9 px grey sticker outline behind pop words; grey connecting words on the white card
the card's edge stop and the 216 px grid lines
brand red: chip text, the red X, red bars, red words on the white card, the ink wipe's droplets
the hard offset shadow under slam words
the centre stop of the red card's radial gradient
the white grid card's centre (the breather card)
the white grid card's edge and its 120 px grid

type.emphasis: scale 2-3x, slam with a hard shadow, or a Six Caps key word

banned: capitalised Poppins: main words are lowercase (only Six Caps key words are uppercase)
a third colour on the red card: white words, red and dark red only (plus the dark UI panels)
red type on the red card: red words live on the white card only
words off-screen, overlapping, or crammed: one stack, centred, inside the safe zones
thin or light weights for main words (Poppins Black 900 only; Bold for chips)
real logos, app screens or brand marks: UI is rebuilt as generic vector mock-ups
slow fades and long eases: everything springs or snaps in within a few frames
grain, glows or gradients on type (only the soft shadow, the sticker outline or the hard slam shadow)
